title: messages.jsonl line
description: One line of the transcript of a run, outputVersion 1: one message as sent to one connection, in send order. Keys are additive within a major version of the sandbox, so a reader ignores a key it does not know.

seq.description: The position of the line in the transcript.

at.description: When the message was sent: ISO 8601, UTC, millisecond precision.

msgType.description: The wire msgType the payload itself carries.

offset.description: The offset as sent; null for a message that carries none.

matchId.description: The match id as sent, assigned at playback. Runs under one apiKey value are told apart by it.

scriptIndex.description: The case script entry the message came from, its zero-based position in script; a snapshot message carries the index of the entry whose state it reflects.

payload.description: The JSON form of the message exactly as sent, after the playback rewrite of ids, offsets and timestamps.
